pair.human_continuation: The changes would save £300m a year from prison budgets by 2015/16, he said. BBC home affairs correspondent Danny Shaw said the number of prison officers, governors and support staff in public sector jails had fallen by 10,000 since 2010 - with half of the jobs going since 2013. Some prisons have had to recruit former prison officers and use officers from other establishments due to staff shortages, our correspondent said. Prison inspectors and other experts have said staffing problems have contributed to a worsening performance of a number of jails, although a major recruitment and training exercise is ongoing with 1,700 new prison officers due to be in place by April.
